sql: WITH mm AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker, strategy FROM live_orders WHERE strategy IN ('Lmmsell10','Lmmsell8','mmsell10','mmsell10a','mmsell10b') AND action='buy'), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker, p.quantity, p.realized_pnl FROM positions p JOIN mm ON mm.market_ticker=p.market_ticker ORDER BY p.market_ticker,p.captured_at DESC) SELECT mm.strategy, split_part(mm.market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, count(*) AS settled_markets, round(sum(l.realized_pnl)::numeric,2) AS realized_dollars, round(avg(l.realized_pnl)::numeric,4) AS avg_dollars FROM latest l JOIN mm ON mm.market_ticker=l.market_ticker WHERE l.quantity=0 AND l.realized_pnl IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mm.strategy, split_part(mm.market_ticker,'-',1) ORDER BY realized_dollars ASC
